name: title_case
title: Title Case
description: Capitalises the first letter of every word and lowercases the rest: "aNNA de LIMA" becomes "Anna De Lima".
author: ParVu

body.source:
array_to_string(
  list_transform(string_split(lower(text), ' '), lambda w: upper(left(w, 1)) || substr(w, 2)),
  ' ')
